title: Hereford Cattle Herd at Farm Barn, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Vintage sepia-toned photograph capturing a herd of Hereford cattle standing in a muddy farmyard directly in front of a dark wooden barn. A person wearing a cowboy hat is partially visible behind the center bull. The image evokes 20th-century American agricultural heritage and rural livestock farming life.
